title: A full-service assembly and packaging facility.
lede: From raw material coordination through final packaging and shipping, we run complete and partial product assembly under one roof — built for high-volume, labour-intensive work with assured on-time delivery.

sections.heading: What we handle
paragraphs: Our packaging and assembly capability covers raw material coordination, inventory management, assembly line production, inspection, final packaging and shipping — combining modern equipment with staff attention to detail to keep both cost and turnaround predictable.

capabilityGrid.title: Tack & Custom Welding
capabilityGrid.description: Precision welding for component assembly, including custom configurations.

capabilityGrid.title: Brazing
capabilityGrid.description: Joining processes for components that need a stronger bond than welding alone.

capabilityGrid.title: Color Coding
capabilityGrid.description: Visual identification systems applied across product lines.

capabilityGrid.title: Finishing
capabilityGrid.description: Surface finishing for a consistent final appearance.

capabilityGrid.title: Laser Etching & Engraving
capabilityGrid.description: Permanent marking for traceability and branding.

capabilityGrid.title: Inspection, Sorting & Rework
capabilityGrid.description: Detailed process analysis to catch and correct non-conforming parts before they ship.

sections.heading: What partnering with us saves you

capabilityGrid.title: Lower Staffing Overhead
capabilityGrid.description: Reduced need for in-house assembly and packaging teams.

capabilityGrid.title: Lower Warehousing Cost
capabilityGrid.description: Less space tied up holding partially assembled inventory.

capabilityGrid.title: Lower Transport Cost
capabilityGrid.description: Fewer shipping legs between assembly and final delivery.

capabilityGrid.title: Centralised Control
capabilityGrid.description: One location accountable for the full assembly and packaging run.

faqs.question: Does Modern Orthodontics offer full or partial product assembly?
faqs.answer: Both — our facility is built for complete and partial product assembly depending on what a project needs.

faqs.question: What finishing services are available alongside packaging?
faqs.answer: Tack and custom welding, brazing, colour coding, surface finishing, laser etching and engraving, plus inspection, sorting and rework.

faqs.question: Can packaging be customised for our brand?
faqs.answer: Yes, custom labelling and packaging are part of the standard assembly and packaging service.

faqs.question: What cost savings come from outsourcing assembly and packaging to MO?
faqs.answer: Most partners reduce in-house assembly and packaging staffing, cut warehousing and transport costs, and gain centralised inventory control.
